source_policy: original prior Qv6 frozen SHA sorted first 96 ARC train question IDs and full pinned Qwen token IDs; no new source selection based on model output
evaluation_selection: sort SHA256(dataset_revision+'/validation/'+ind), choose first 48 whose one-token common-prefix A/B/C/D, prompt 18..208 ids, complete nonduplicate fields; no source overlap
evaluation_motivator: narrative commonsense four-ending choice prompts, new corpus and domain vs earlier ARC/OpenBookQA science evaluation; still development not pristine heldout
prompt_template: Qwen2.5 ChatML user with context, four candidate endings A-D, instruction Answer using exactly one letter A/B/C/D; assistant-generation prefix; exact same four single-token choices
training_gradient: original BF16 (no quantized forward), correct single-letter CausalLM next token loss per sample, for each of 196 tensor compute g_s dot (native BEGLIN Q4(W)-W) and g_s dot (native BEGLIN qNg64-n8(W)-W), signed with float64 summation
source_sampling: 96 source rows; original BF16 exact pinned model; original C group64 encoder residual FP16 intermediate; no downstream full model tensor replacement
objective_expression: for x_i in {0,1} 8bit upgrade, r_s(x)=sum_i [a_si+x_i*(b_si-a_si)], a_si=grad_si dot native_Q4_resid_i, b_si=grad_si dot native_n8_resid_i; minimize (1/96) sum_s r_s(x)^2
objective_assumptions: first-order Taylor of correct-token NLL against full model weight changes; squared signed predicted loss displacement, captures cross tensor interactions but not higher-order Hessian, per-token generative quality or exact full model response; cancellation can mislead
optimizer: deterministic strictly-feasible 1-swap coordinate descent of quadratic source objective, 28/196 n8 fixed, start masks prior Qv6 source 64 and 128 and random initial feasible if possible; source seeds 17,41,73; no global optimality claim
native_engine: same actual original Qv5 BEGLIN 28layer audited mixed CPU backend for all three mixed masks; Q4 base binary from same source revision
eval_metrics: four-choice correct count and per-case correct-token full-vocab NLL, paired bootstrap B=5000 deterministic seed 20261022; original BF16 Transformers MPS separate reference
potential_confound: BF16 Torch vs native widened-F32 numerical differences; all mixed same BEGLIN C binary; 48 HellaSwag questions exploratory, not model-family generalization
pass_criteria: native 4-arm actually executed and independent audit PASS, not enough for global quality superiority; new data/model/cost proof required before promotion
